_meta.note: Hand-authored. Choices a feat asks for in prose only, which the corpus carries in no structured field ('choose one of the following damage types'). Structured choices are read from the corpus directly: optionalfeatureProgression (Martial Adept's maneuvers), weaponProficiencies with choose (Weapon Master's weapons), additionalSpells, proficiencies, expertise, savingThrowProficiencies. A test checks every row names a feat the corpus has. See documentation/CHARGEN-WIZARD.md §8.

fields.id: the question's key under the feat: choices['feat.<name|source>.choice.<id>']
fields.label: what is chosen, shown with the question
fields.options: the values; damage types by their lower-case key, shown in the reader's language
fields.repeatable: the feat may be taken again, each time with another value — where only its text says so (the 2024 record carries 'repeatable')
